note: Every 3D object is loaded through this file. 'available: false' means the GLB does not exist yet and the procedural fallback shape is used (render/carModel.ts, render/tileBuilder.ts). Drop the optimised GLB (see scripts/optimize-models.mjs) at the path, set available to true, nothing else changes. GLB conventions: units = metres, +z is the nose, y = 0 on the ground, wheels as nodes named wheel_fl / wheel_fr / wheel_rl / wheel_rr (optional).
